name: Principal Inquisitor
gmNotes: Principal Inquisitor is Green's current IA title — a senior rank within Internal Affairs, above ordinary IA Agent. It records the office, not biology; the holder's Species is recorded separately on their character. Titles change: when a character's title changes, update the archetypes on their file. The title grants no automatic mechanics.
description: A senior investigator of the Internal Affairs — the one who asks the final questions when an inquiry will not close. The title carries weight, and its holder is rarely turned away.
